archetype: Product Owner in fintech (English-language profile, German B2)
summary: Product Owner with nine years in payments and open banking. I translate regulatory and customer needs into prioritised backlogs, work daily with engineering teams of 6-9 people and own the quarterly roadmap for a card and account-information product. Comfortable with SQL for my own analyses.
